subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The measures proposed by the committee (1)/ are not only meant to improve institutional efficiency (2)/ but also addressing the disparities in resource sharing (3)/ across underdeveloped regions. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the sentence lies in **part 3**, which reads: "but also addressing the disparities in resource sharing."
 
• The phrase "but also addressing" is grammatically incorrect because it does not parallel the structure of the earlier phrase "are not only meant to improve."
 
• The correct parallel structure would be "but also meant to address."
 
• Ensuring parallelism in such constructions is crucial for grammatical accuracy and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The measures proposed by the committee are not only meant to improve institutional efficiency but also meant to address the disparities in resource sharing across underdeveloped regions."*
